prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: wide GitHub README hero banner, intended to display at about 900px wide; produce a 3:1 landscape composition, approximately 1800x600.
Create a beautiful, understated cinematic brand banner for watch.local, a self-hosted streaming app for a home network. The attached icon is a brand reference only: preserve the distinctive rounded white WL monogram and cyan dot if you include it; do not redesign the logo.
Scene: an almost-black charcoal studio background with a subtle cyan rim light, an elegant flowing glass ribbon and three floating rounded cinematic image panels receding into depth on the right. The panels show original atmospheric landscape photography: a misty mountain, an ocean at blue hour, and a warm sunlit desert. These are conceptual artwork, not screenshots or a fake UI. Polished smoked glass, gentle reflections, premium editorial restraint. No people, movie posters, streaming service logos, extra badges, or decorations.
Composition: ample negative space, confident left-aligned white typography on the left, image panels on the right with cyan edges. All content has generous outer padding. Keep the design legible when scaled down.
Exact text, only these two lines:
"watch.local"
"Any stream on any screen"
The first line is large and bold in a clean contemporary sans-serif; second line smaller, muted light gray. Colors: near-black #090b10, white #f5f5f7, restrained cyan #6bd3f3. No purple neon, no rainbow gradients. Flat edge-to-edge rectangular banner, not a photo of a banner. Opaque background.
finalRevision: Edit this watch.local GitHub README banner. Change only the small tagline underneath "watch.local" from "Your library. Your screen." to the exact text "Any stream on any screen". Keep the new tagline on one line, using the same muted light-gray sans-serif style and left alignment, fitting comfortably in the existing left text area. Preserve everything else: the white WL monogram and cyan dot, the large watch.local wordmark, the black background, all three photographic glass panels on the right, the flowing cyan glass ribbon, dimensions, colors, lighting, and layout. Do not add any other text or punctuation.
flowGraphic: stream-flow.svg is a hand-authored SVG showing Resolve → Verify → Play.
